research_question: Which anonymous design is the stronger, narrower and more falsifiable first-paper plan for testing whether scribble intent is state-relative to patient-excluded OOF M0, without changing the frozen six-joint ontology or claiming results?

rubric.Q1: Hypothesis specificity, state-relative interpretation and explicit falsifiability.
rubric.Q2: Respect for PET/CT, anatomy, scribble generation and clinical/domain reality.
rubric.Q3: Implementable mechanism with explicit inputs, outputs, tensor/contracts and simple-first boundary.
rubric.Q4: Causal discrimination against cue/geometry shortcuts, confounds and leakage.
rubric.Q5: Fidelity to operation={ADD,REMOVE}, target={SAME,NEW}, scope={LOCAL,COMPLETE}, six legal joints, fixed dataset/splits and first-paper scope.
rubric.Q6: Valid patient-level experiment, estimand, endpoint, comparator fairness, uncertainty and multiplicity plan.
rubric.Q7: Reproducibility and execution readiness: manifests, seeds, receipts, failure gates and resource assumptions.
rubric.Q8: Truth boundary: DESIGN_ONLY, no fabricated novelty/results/readiness, current versus future separation.

acceptance_thresholds.finding_replication_required: At least two of three judges must independently use the same replication_key, candidate and kind for a system-level repair gate.

commitment_output_contract.note: Each reviewer freezes its own expected failure modes and rejection conditions before seeing either candidate.
